basis: Defective thyroid iodide transport causes congenital hypothyroidism; no other common direct organ damage established.
Disorder of articular cartilage; immune-mediated disease is confined to particular subtypes.
Inherited enlargement of red blood cells; nonspecific metabolic HPO annotation does not establish a metabolic disorder.
Mesenchymal soft-tissue sarcoma of the retroperitoneum; proximity to abdominal organs does not establish their involvement.
Definition specifies ALK-related neuroblastoma, a malignancy arising from sympathetic neural tissue.
B-cell lymphoma; gastrointestinal occupation occurs in roughly half. Supplied HPO reports pulmonary infiltrates in 80-99%, supporting pulmonary involvement.
Benign smooth-muscle tumor arising in the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Short-rib skeletal dysplasia; stage 5 kidney disease in 2/2 patients. Hepatic cysts alone do not establish liver dysfunction.
Defined by cerebellar/peripheral neurologic disease, retinal dystrophy and pituitary hormone deficiency with hypogonadism.
Inherited cone-rod retinal degeneration causes visual impairment; no extraocular damage established.
Lysosomal storage with defining skeletal and cognitive disease; cardiac disease 80-99%. Common airway, corneal and hearing damage omitted because of the cap.
Neurodevelopmental disorder; ASD 3/5, VSD 2/5; sensorineural hearing loss 2/4, borderline overall 2/7. Ocular/airway findings too sparsely sampled.
WT1-associated glomerular disease with nephrotic syndrome and progressive renal failure; gonadal tumors are uncommon.
Chronic skin thickening and injury from repeated scratching or rubbing; the name does not imply neurologic disease.
Carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ; HPV association alone does not make the tumor an infection.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; cerebral atrophy/dystonia each 2/4, maculopathy 3/4. Individual cardiac phenotypes are 1/4; overlap is unknown.
Definition specifies a malignant glial tumor arising in the central nervous system.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation directly injures lung tissue; idiopathic pneumonia here does not imply infection.
Epithelial neoplasm originates in the vermiform appendix.
Focal epilepsy produces auditory sensory seizures; these do not establish damage to the ear or hearing apparatus.
Neural tube defect defined by a subcutaneous lipoma extending through a vertebral arch defect into spinal neural structures; common bladder injury not established here.
Destruction of alveolar walls and loss of functional lung tissue; cardiovascular complications are not universal defining features.
Excessive thickening of bone; no additional organ damage applies across the umbrella concept.
Defined by severe intestinal hypoperistalsis with microcolon and an enlarged dysfunctional urinary bladder; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Yolk sac tumor originates in the ovary; germ-cell origin does not establish endocrine dysfunction or another axis.
